en.activity: Rolls-Royce Holdings plc designs and manages mission-critical power systems in the United Kingdom and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Civil Aerospace, Defence, and Power Systems.
en.products: Rolls-Royce Holdings plc designs and manages mission-critical power systems in the United Kingdom and internationally. The Civil Aerospace segment develops, manufactures, markets, and sells aero engines for large commercial aircraft, regional jet, and business aviation markets, as well as provides aftermarket services.
